text:
zoe (Marketing): Quick draft for a one-pager and short launch play: 'Guardian Quick Brief' 1-page exec + single benchmark slide + 25m webinar + inbound routing rules for enterprise. Need fast eyes. TL;DR: emphasize SLAs, private deployment options, and measurement transparency.

kai (Product): Nice and concise. Please include model pinning note and automatic fallback to a lower-capacity variant. Also add a single sentence about key management (KMS) support for Private.

tess (Field): For the benchmark slide I suggest a burst test (peak 120 concurrent, seq=128) using model=redwood-edge-quant. Proposed numbers: Hosted p50=95ms p99=310ms; Dedicated p50=28ms p99=48ms; throughput ~180 req/s per GPU. Add a short "how we measured" line.

omar (Sales): Inbound routing guidance: tag leads with {segment: enterprise, interest: private-deploy, compliance: yes}. If they request on-prem add escalation tag. Route enterprise+private to AE-enterprise and on-prem to infra-specialist. Capture expected peak qps on form.

tess (Field): Small ops snippet to hand to infra (YAML):
```yaml
routing:
  - match: tags.segment == 'enterprise' and tags.interest == 'private-deploy'
    route_to: queue.AE-enterprise
    priority: 85
  - match: tags.onprem == true
    route_to: queue.infra-specialist
    priority: 98
  - fallback: queue.sdr-inbound
```

kai (Product): SLA blurb for the one-pager suggestion: "SLA: 99.95% uptime for Dedicated plans. Latency SLOs published per deployment; we offer custom SLOs and on-prem guarantees as part of contracted onboarding. Automatic model-variant fallback helps avoid hard failures during capacity events."

zoe (Marketing): Webinar sketch: 25m total -> 5m market framing + 9m demo (deploy modes + console walkthrough) + 8m benchmarks & measurement notes + 3m CTAs/Q&A. CTA: request a private trial or schedule a deeper tech call. Omar will own CTAs.

omar (Sales): I'll add registration fields: company size, compliance needs, expected peak qps, preferred deployment (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). Add an urgency toggle if they need a pilot in <30 days.

ops-bot: Assets uploaded: /assets/guardian/onepager-v1.pdf and /assets/guardian/webinar-landing.html. Docs reference: https://playbook.internal/guardian-brief.

tess (Field): Customer blurb for slide 1 (two lines): "Northbridge ran a private pilot with Redwood Dedicated and cut inference cost by ~2.9x while meeting a 99.95% uptime target. The pilot used dedicated GPUs in a VPC with full audit logs."

zoe (Marketing): Two quick asks before I publish v1: (1) @tess confirm Northbridge line is okay to publish, (2) @kai confirm Dedicated p99 number so we can lock the benchmark. If both good I'll finalize the one-pager and push the launch post + webinar invite. Thanks! :sparkles:
